name.en: Zhangke Hemiao Fund (Zhangjiang Life & Health Industry Incubation Angel Fund)
name.local: 张科禾苗基金（张江生命健康产业孵化天使基金）

aka: 张江生命健康产业孵化天使基金

strategy.thesis: State-platform-sponsored angel-stage fund set up by Zhangjiang Sci-tech Investment (张江科投), the investment arm of Shanghai's Zhangjiang Group, to co-invest at the seed/angel round alongside founders and other early investors in Zhangjiang's life-and-health cluster, focused exclusively on innovative drugs, medical devices, cell & gene therapy and synthetic biology, plugging the capital gap right after lab-to-company technology transfer.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operated by Zhangjiang Kechuang, described as part of an '投贷孵学' (invest-lend-incubate-educate) platform pairing incubation with early capital in the Zhangjiang Pharma Valley biomedical hub.

summary.en: A health-focused angel-stage fund established by Zhangjiang Group's investment platform (张江科投) in Shanghai's Zhangjiang biopharma hub, dedicated to early/seed investing in innovative drugs, medical devices, cell & gene therapy and synthetic biology startups spinning out of the park's incubation pipeline.
summary.local: 由上海张江集团旗下投资平台张江科投设立的健康聚焦天使期基金，专注于张江生物医药产业园早期孵化项目在创新药、医疗器械、细胞与基因治疗、合成生物学等赛道的天使轮投资。

sources.title: 寻找"创新种子"，探索超前孵化，张江集团助力更多高质量科技成果落地
sources.publisher: 上海市浦东新区国有资产监督管理委员会 (Shanghai Pudong New Area SASAC)
sources.supports: Existence, sponsor, sector focus (innovative drugs, medical devices, cell & gene therapy, synthetic biology), and early-stage/angel-round mandate of the fund
sources.quote: 针对生命健康产业，张江科投推动设立了张科禾苗基金，聚焦创新药、医疗器械、细胞与基因治疗、合成生物学等优势赛道的早期投资

sources.title: 近50亿！162家资本下注张江生物药企
sources.supports: Corroborates Zhangjiang biopharma cluster's investor ecosystem and early-stage capital activity

verification_notes: No standalone official website for the fund itself was located (only mentions in Zhangjiang Group / Pudong SASAC and industry-media coverage); fund size and exact founding date are undisclosed in available sources. Classified as angel-syndicate/SPV-style vehicle since it is a single state-platform-sponsored fund that co-invests at the angel/seed round rather than a membership network of independent angels; subtype government-program noted because sponsor Zhangjiang Kechuang is a Shanghai SOE investment platform.
